symptomReferences.parent: Puis., rheum, rhus-t., secale, sep., sil.,

sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Occipital pain, with nausea on rising, fol-
lowed by vomiting. Influenza, with aching pains all
over, and heat in the limbs. Ozcena; frontal pain.

sections.label: Stomach
sections.text:
Loathing of food; nausea on rising, fol-
lowed by vomiting and cramps. Stools watery, frothy.

sections.label: Extremities
sections.text:
Stiffness of all joints; calves numb;
aching in bones. Rheumatic pain in back. Pains in

sections.label: Skin
sections.text:
Itching welts. Urticaria from gastric de-
rangement.

Doee. — Sixth potency.
